summary: Use a Dropdown as the floating panel for a short list of choices or actions that opens from a button or field.

useWhen.text: As the floating panel for a short list of choices or actions that opens from a button or field.

from.quote: Use a Dropdown as the floating panel for a short list of choices or actions that opens from a button or field.

useWhen.text: For example, a menu from an overflow (More) button, with actions such as Download statement, Share statement and Report a problem.

from.quote: A menu from an overflow button

avoidWhen.text: A form field that opens a list of options: for form fields, DropdownInput opens, closes and places the Dropdown.

from.quote: opening, closing, and placing it are handled by the screen, or by Dropdown Input for form fields.

anatomy.holds: Rounded surface with a soft shadow that floats over content; it holds the items, each a DropdownItem (children).

from.quote: Rounded surface with a soft shadow that floats over content.

anatomy.holds: One choice or action in one line: a DropdownItem with a label and an optional leading icon.

from.quote: One choice or action in one line.

anatomy.holds: Grey fill and a check mark the current choice (selected on its DropdownItem).

from.quote: Grey fill and a check mark the current choice.

anatomy.holds: Appears on the selected item unless it has its own trailing content (trailing on its DropdownItem).

from.quote: Appears on the selected item unless it has its own trailing content.

placementAdvice.text: Keep it a short, scannable list; the screen decides when it opens and where it sits.

from.quote: A short, scannable list; the screen decides when it opens and where it sits.

placementAdvice.text: Dropdown draws the panel and its items; opening, closing and placing it are handled by the screen, or by DropdownInput for form fields.

from.quote: Dropdown draws the panel and its items; opening, closing, and placing it are handled by the screen, or by Dropdown Input for form fields.

placementAdvice.text: For a menu from an overflow button, the screen opens the Dropdown when the More button is pressed, places it under the button, and closes it after a choice; Dropdown itself only draws the panel.

from.quote: The screen opens the Dropdown when the More button is pressed, places it under the button, and closes it after a choice. Dropdown only draws the panel.

placementAdvice.text: The screen sets the panel's width (in the guide, a width on the Dropdown's style: 240, or 220 for the menu); the items fill it.

from.quote: The screen sets the width

placementAdvice.text: Items are 43 px tall and fill the panel’s width.

from.quote: Items are 43 px tall and fill the panel’s width.

configuration.text: Each item is a DropdownItem: it takes a label and an optional leading icon.

from.quote: Items take a label and an optional leading icon.

configuration.text: A list of labels alone is the simplest list, for choices people know by name.

from.quote: The simplest list, for choices people know by name.

configuration.text: Add a leading icon (an Icon in leading) when it helps people scan similar items.

from.quote: Icons help people scan similar items.

configuration.text: Labels stay on one line and end in an ellipsis when they run out of room.

from.quote: Labels stay on one line and end in an ellipsis when they run out of room.

configuration.text: Set a maximum height (maxHeight) when the list is long so the panel scrolls instead of growing.

from.quote: Set a maximum height when the list is long so the panel scrolls instead of growing.

configuration.text: With maxHeight, the panel stays the same height and the list scrolls inside it.

from.quote: The panel stays the same height and the list scrolls.

configuration.text: Don't let a long list grow without a max height: in the guide, twelve items push the panel far past the screen.

from.quote: Twelve items push the panel far past the screen.

configuration.text: Mark the current choice as selected (selected on its DropdownItem): it gets a grey fill and a check.

from.quote: Mark the current choice as selected

configuration.text: In a single-choice list, mark one current choice: two checks make the current choice unclear.

from.quote: Two checks make the current choice unclear.

configuration.text: Dim options that are temporarily unavailable (disabled on their DropdownItem): they cannot be pressed or focused.

from.quote: dim options that are temporarily unavailable.

rules.text: Start each label with the key word: put the word that tells items apart first.

from.quote: Put the word that tells items apart first

rules.text: Keep labels to a few words, so every label reads in full.

from.quote: keep labels to a few words

rules.text: Use the same form for every item, such as all actions (Download statement, Share statement) or all choices (Savings account, Checking account).

from.quote: use the same form for every item.

rules.text: Don't write long labels: they are cut off, hiding what tells them apart.

from.quote: Long labels are cut off, hiding what tells them apart.

    <DropdownItem label="Share statement" onPress={() => {}} />
    <DropdownItem label="Report a problem" onPress={() => {}} />

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the popup before its content becomes scrollable. Defaults to no limit.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the popup container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the menu surface.

props.name: nativeID
props.description: DOM id so the open menu can be focused and referenced.

props.name: focusable
props.description: When true on web, the listbox is a tab stop (tabIndex 0) so a modal focus trap lands on the menu instead of a backdrop. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: DropdownItem.label
props.description: On DropdownItem: the item's text, on one line; a long label is cut with an ellipsis.

props.name: DropdownItem.leading
props.description: On DropdownItem: content before the label, such as an Icon; a registry icon shows at 18 px in the brand gold when no colour is given.

props.name: DropdownItem.trailing
props.description: On DropdownItem: content after the label; when set, it replaces the selected item's check.

props.name: DropdownItem.selected
props.description: On DropdownItem: marks the current choice; on the web the option has aria-selected=true, so it is announced as selected.

props.name: DropdownItem.disabled
props.description: On DropdownItem: in a standalone Dropdown on the web, enabled options are tab stops (tabindex 0) and a disabled option leaves the tab order (tabindex -1).

props.name: DropdownItem.onPress
props.description: On DropdownItem: the press handler. In a standalone Dropdown, Enter and Space each call it once (#209 fixed), so an action item runs once.

modes.name: Dropdown Item State
modes.description: A token collection Dropdown reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: A standalone Dropdown has no arrow-key navigation: arrow keys don’t move between options (Tab, Enter and Space do). Inside DropdownInput the field handles the keyboard.
Hover and press use the same grey as selected, so a hovered item looks selected: there is no separate hover or pressed colour.
